biggest_catch: You only get paid if your friend becomes a DFCU member and closes on a DFCU mortgage within 6 months of completing the ReferLive registration. A friend who joins and only opens a checking account falls under the $100 checking tier (R4316), not this one.
catches: New member must close on a DFCU mortgage within 6 months of completing the ReferLive registration.
Not available to referred persons who are already DFCU members.
U.S. residents only; home lending subject to credit and property approval.
Reward Card arrives 4-6 weeks after qualifications are completed.
DFCU may amend, suspend, or terminate the referral program at any time without notice.
Tax treatment not stated; treat as potentially reportable income.

steps: Register for the DFCU ReferLive referral program.
Share the referral offer with friends and family.
Friend becomes a DFCU member, completes ReferLive registration, and closes on a DFCU mortgage within 6 months.
You receive a $275 Reward card per qualifying mortgage referral.
timing: Reward Card arrives 4-6 weeks after the referred person closes on the mortgage.
when_cash_arrives: Reward Card arrives 4-6 weeks after the referred person closes on the mortgage. Paid only when your friend's loan is approved, closed, and funded.
maximize: Pre-qualify your friend (credit score, income docs, loan purpose) before the formal application so underwriting does not stall.
Refer people already shopping for that exact loan type (auto, personal) - cold referrals rarely convert to funded loans.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: application to underwriting to funding is a multi-week pipeline you cannot accelerate - loan referrals are the slowest conversion type.
